variants.name: status-quo
variants.description: What a NON-CRON bossd-spawned session pays today (interactive, tmux_unattended, --detach): the boss --mcp-config MERGED with repo-root .mcp.json (duplicate bossanova stdio server + Linear + Sentry), plus every skill and agent this machine has installed. Cron spawns are NOT this shape — StrictMcpConfigForSession makes them strict, so they never read repo-root .mcp.json and never pay the duplicate.

variants.name: status-quo-minus-dup
variants.description: Status quo minus the duplicate bossanova stdio registration of the same boss daemon. Strict mode makes the curated config the whole surface, so Linear and Sentry are restated here to hold everything else constant.

variants.name: boss-omitted-remotes-wired
variants.description: What a spawn pays AFTER the boss MCP server stopped being wired by default: the two third-party HTTP remotes under strict mode, with no boss stdio server and so no mcp__boss__* tool schemas. Take the delta against status-quo-minus-dup, NOT status-quo — minus-dup is the same three servers under strict mode, which is what a spawn actually pays today now that strictness is unconditional, so the pair isolates exactly one boss MCP copy with the remotes held constant. Expect roughly 20k, not the whole fixed prefix: the 2026-08-03 baseline measured one boss copy at 20,369-20,507 tokens (curated-boss-only 89,335 vs no-mcp 68,966). Run the two in ISOLATION — Claude's ephemeral prompt cache lives ~5 minutes, so back-to-back variants land inside each other's window and a byte-identical prefix can report cache_creation_input_tokens: 0, which once scored as a nonsense 110k saving.

variants.name: curated-boss-only
variants.description: The boss daemon MCP alone, strictly curated: no Linear, no Sentry, no repo .mcp.json merge.

variants.name: no-mcp
variants.description: No MCP surface at all. --strict-mcp-config with NO --mcp-config would strip the boss server too, so this variant passes an empty-but-valid config document rather than the bare flag.

variants.name: no-agents
variants.description: NULL CONTROL, not a saving. `claude --help` documents --agents as 'JSON object defining custom agents' — it is ADDITIVE, so --agents '{}' defines zero extra agents and cannot remove the installed catalogue. Its delta is 0 by construction; the row's value is proving the harness reproduces a byte-identical prefix at exactly 0. Sizing the agent catalogue needs a different mechanism (--setting-sources / --bare), not this flag.
